question: In February 2022, where was India's most powerful supercomputer Param Pravega launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IISc Bengaluru**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Param Pravega** is India's most powerful supercomputer as of February 2022.
 
• It was launched at the **Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru**.
 
• The supercomputer is part of the National Supercomputing Mission (NSM).
 
• It aims to boost India's computing power significantly and support various research and development activities.
 
• Param Pravega has a computing power of 3.3 petaflops.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Supercomputing Mission (NSM)** is an initiative by the Government of India to enhance the country's supercomputing capabilities.
 
• The mission is jointly steered by the Department of Science and Technology (DST) and the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
 
• The mission's objective is to install a network of supercomputers across academic and research institutions in India.
 
• These supercomputers will be used for various applications, including scientific research, weather forecasting, and drug discovery.
